name: primitives-headless-popover
title: Headless Popover
description: A Quick settings button opens a small floating card with a short explanation and a Save changes button; the card scales up from the trigger and shrinks away on close.
use: A few settings or a short note should open in place without leaving the page.
avoid: The panel is narrow and its content is fixed, so longer forms or lists will not fit.
a11y: Escape closes and focus is managed, but the demo removes the focus outline without a ring, so keyboard focus is invisible. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A compact outlined button on black labelled Quick settings. Below it sits a floating dark card with the same heading, two lines of grey copy and a full-width white Save changes button.
behaves: Clicking the button pops the card open beneath it, growing from half scale with a spring while it fades in. Clicking again, or outside, shrinks it back toward the button.
customise: Compose the trigger, panel and optional backdrop with your own markup, and set the transition or placement; the scale-and-fade animation is fixed.
weight: light: One small panel scaling in; nothing runs while closed.
